requirement: Sellers can publish an andean instrument
expected: The sell form accepts Andinos y tradicionales → Instrumento andino with an Instrumento attribute; the database accepts the pair and refuses other types in it

requirement: Search finds andean instruments by name and by the words andino or folklore
expected: charango, "zampoña", "siku" and "andino" open the category or find its listings

requirement: Saved alerts keep the new category and attribute
expected: An alert for Andinos · Quena saves and matches new quenas
steps: Save the search and publish a matching listing; `tests/feat-discovery.sql`

requirement: Store imports map andean category names
expected: Andinos, "Folklore" and "Instrumentos andinos" import into the category
steps: Import a sheet with those names

requirement: A store declares itself Fabricante or Taller with its city
expected: The profile saves from Mi tienda → Fabricante o Taller; a particular, another owner or an anonymous visitor cannot

requirement: A maker marks a listing Hecho a mano and Se hace a pedido
expected: The edit page shows the fields only to makers; weeks are 1 to 26; the listing page shows the marks with whose word they are
steps: Edit the listing and open it

requirement: Marks never show on non-public listings
expected: get_listing_marks leaves out pending, hidden and sold listings

requirement: Hecho en Perú lists the makers and their handmade listings
expected: /hecho-en-peru shows verified makers first with in-stock handmade listings; an empty state when there are none

requirement: Admin hides a maker profile with a reason
expected: The profile leaves the page, the store page and every mark; the owner cannot edit it; the action is audited

requirement: Turning the maker off clears its listing marks
expected: Hecho a mano and the weeks disappear from the store's listings
steps: Mi tienda → Fabricante o Taller → No

requirement: Admin verifies an artist on an existing account
expected: Saving needs the account's e-mail, a slug, a name and how the identity was checked; the check goes to the audit only; slugs are unique

requirement: Only a verified artist adds a use note to a listing
expected: Others get "Solo un artista verificado por Laria puede agregar esta nota."

requirement: The listing shows the artist with whose word the note is
expected: Artista verificado with the name, the note and the disclaimer
preconditions: Verified artist with a noted listing

requirement: Revoking an artist removes them everywhere at once
expected: The name, the note and the /artistas entry disappear; the action is audited

requirement: /artistas lists the artists and their newest listings
expected: Each artist with story, link and up to four listings; the e-mail invitation to apply

requirement: /guias lists the nine buying guides
expected: Each guide opens at /guias/<slug> and is in the sitemap

requirement: A try-out checklist can be ticked on the phone
expected: Ticks count up and reset; nothing is saved
steps: Open a "Qué revisar" guide at 390 px and tick items

requirement: A listing links the guides for its kind
expected: Antes de ir a verlo appears on unsold listings of covered categories, and not on sold ones
steps: Open a guitar, a bass and a sold listing

requirement: /regalos finds gifts by recipient and budget
expected: Choosing a recipient and a budget shows real listings per set with Ver todo, the tip and the questions

requirement: Occasion pages use the same finder without urgency
expected: /regalos/navidad and the other three occasions show occasion copy and no countdown, deadline or "last days" text

requirement: A store offers gift exchanges
expected: 3 to 60 days with an optional condition; only stores; the gift page lists active stores with the disclaimer
steps: Mi tienda → Fabricante o Taller → Cambios de regalos; `tests/feat-discovery.sql`

requirement: A hidden store leaves the gift exchange list
expected: Its policy stops being public

requirement: Admin saves a collection from catalog links
expected: Title, text, dates and one to four groups pasted from /listados; bad links and lengths are refused beside the field

requirement: Only published collections inside their dates are public
expected: Drafts, future and past collections are not readable by visitors; Admin sees all

requirement: The home shows up to three current collections and Para regalar
expected: Without collections the row is "Ideas para buscar" with the gift card only

requirement: A collection page shows each group's newest listings
expected: Each group shows listings and "Ver las N" opening the same catalog results

requirement: Collection changes are audited
expected: Saving and deleting record an Admin audit entry

expected: ux-copy and ux-contrast tests pass; no urgency, no exclamation marks, Spanish with tildes
